messages.content: What position did the Mangaboo Prince offer if the Wizard beat the Sorcerer?
Chief Wizard of the domain.
How big was the first piglet the Wizard produced beneath his hat?
No bigger than a mouse.
Why did Zeb put out the lanterns when the tunnel grew lighter?
To save the oil.
What color was the light they saw next?
White.
What stone was the mountain on the Voe side compared to?
Granite.
What fruit did the Wizard compare the look of dama-fruit to?
A peach.
What hid the view from the third landing on the mountain?
Thick banks of clouds.
What kind of opening did the Gargoyles push the prisoners through?
A broad opening high beneath the roof.
How did they cross the deep cracks in the floor beyond the Gargoyles?
They jumped over them.
What did the Hungry Tiger strike when it knocked Jim over?
Jim's shoulder.
Which animal was crouching on Jim's other side when he came to?
The Cowardly Lion.
Where did Ozma say she had left the piglet when she sent Jellia to get it?
On her dressing table.
